note: Pinchot State Forest rustic camping area: 12 reservable sites in the Moon Lake Recreation Area off Moon Lake Road. A lake is nearby, but the sites are not lakefront. Only three sites list a max vehicle length of 30 ft or more (001 at 40 ft, 003 at 32, 007 at 30); the rest take 16-20 ft. Non-flush toilets; no water, hookups or dump station. Closed November 15 to April 1. --Claude
summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers (state forest rule), non-flush toilets, 12 back-in sites with only three fitting 30-40 ft, reservation required (fcfs never), winter closure Nov 15 - Apr 1. Note corrected: these are rustic campground sites, not dispersed, and most are too short for EKKO. Fees left as recorded (DCNR state forest rate).
